focus_areas: Physical grounding of the wheel (contact patch/shadow existence).
Structural integrity of the central hub (valid cap vs. missing bolts).
Boundary sharpness at the tire-bead seat (no melting/fusion).
Legibility of text decals on the car body.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the geometric relationship between the tire and the ground. Does the tire deform slightly at the bottom? Is there a shadow? If not, it is likely floating. Examine the center of the wheel: is the smooth surface a deliberate design choice (center cap) or did the AI fail to generate bolt holes? Look closely at where the rubber meets the metal rim; there should be a distinct lip or gap, not a blurry transition.
image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a custom chrome alloy car wheel mounted on a red vehicle. The wheel features large, stylized Y-spokes with a highly reflective chrome finish. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim. The background shows the red body panel of the car with some illegible white text decals and strong lens flare/lighting effects.
